verdict.rationale: Runloop is an API-first sandbox platform built to be driven programmatically. It has language SDKs, a CLI with traditional non-interactive commands alongside its TUI, CLI-submitted benchmark jobs that provision and score automatically, and an official deploy-agent GitHub Action for CI workflows. Programmatic command execution and log retrieval round this out. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of non-interactive/CI authentication (e.g., API-key env vars in pipelines), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
